Row.Text: Auto-save Before...
Save before ending the turn
Overwrite BeforeEndTurn before submitting your turn. Continue only after saving succeeds. Keeps one fixed local save.
Save before diplomatic actions

Overwrite BeforeDiplomacy before declarations of war, alliances, diplomatic projects, responses or peace deals during your active single-player turn. Viewing information does not save. Independent of BeforeEndTurn.

Save to BeforeEndTurn before ending your turn and BeforeDiplomacy before diplomatic actions, keeping one fixed slot for each. Toggle them separately in Options → Add-ons, or use the Saves shortcut at the top right. Single-player only.

过回合前自动存档
过回合前覆盖 BeforeEndTurn，确认保存成功后再过回合。只保留一个固定的本地存档。
外交行动前自动存档
在自己的单人活动回合内，宣战、结盟、发起外交项目、回复提议或提交和平协议前覆盖 BeforeDiplomacy。只查看信息不存档；与过回合前存档互不覆盖。
